about.title: About us
about.intro: The Sharif University of Technology Machine Learning Community is a student-led group created by students from Sharif’s mathematics community to support mutual learning and collaboration around ML and the intersection of mathematics and computer science.

mission.label: Mission
mission.text: We create a thoughtful space for learning, discussion, and sharing ideas in machine learning, with the goal of learning together.

mission.label: How we work
mission.text: Beyond regular workshops and sessions, our community works to create a space for connection, growth, and collaboration.

mission.label: What we value
mission.text: We aim to bridge the gap between academia and practice by making the boundary between theory and application less rigid in university life.
